lexicalDecisions.decision: Necessary new 凌ぐしのぐ support. Complete family has transitive godan gu-ending verb senses for enduring/sheltering, pulling through and surpassing. Preserve these branches instead of teaching a single universal English equivalent. Exact written boundary 凌+ぐ supports frozenしの.ぐ; useしのいで/しのいだ, notしのんで. Priority flags establish dictionary prioritization, not a measured frequency claim.

Necessary new 凌駕りょうが support for onリョウ. Noun/suru/transitive surpassing sense. 陵駕 is a rarely used kanji form in this frozen family. Whole word is supported independently by Daijisen; characterリョウ and駕ガ are separately documented. Neither constituent reading is inferred only from a kana substring.

Relatedしのぎ noun/compound families retained in full, but no additional support article is needed. Distinguish derived nounしのぎ from the dictionary verbしのぐ. 凌ぎ also has a funeral-food sense not selected here. The exact其の場凌ぎ alias is search-only; it is not an ordinary production spelling. These families support enduring/tiding-over usage, not a rule that every凌ぐ event must be temporary.

Attested full expressions independently support surpassing young people's vigor, tiding over a crisis, sheltering from weather and eking out a living. They are context evidence, not four required new support articles or independent character readings.

Cloud-height, seaworthiness and plant families are retained but not selected for teaching. 凌霄花 includes whole-wordのうぜんかずら andりょうしょうか; do not inferのう as a new constituent reading. Kana-only plant reading records and通常かな usage are retained with their actual restrictions. Dictionary recognition does not establish that the rare-looking written forms are everyday vocabulary.

Humiliation/assault and historical punishment families inspected but excluded from this bounded learner-visible teaching. Preserve the sexual-assault sense and historical flags in raw evidence; do not collapse them into neutral synonyms or create illustrative examples.
耐えしのぐ/耐え凌ぐ is expressly a non-standard variant of耐え忍ぶ in this frozen family. Do not select it as an ordinary teaching example or confuseしのぐ withしのぶ.

comparisonDecisions.decision: Duplicate occurrences of the selected complete support families in the exact comparison extraction; counted as occurrences, not additional distinct families.

Actual我慢 andこらえる articles overlap with the endurance branch of proposed凌ぐ title. Propose direct凌ぐ exclusions with each, not a transitive exclusion clique. こらえる's suppression/forgiveness senses do not all transfer to凌ぐ; preserve the rare怺える spelling andこたえる reading restriction in raw evidence.

Actual優れる,追い越す and越える articles include ordinary surpassing senses. Propose direct guards from BOTH new words to EACH of these existing identities, despite different displayed titles and越える's preferred crossing focus. The existing越える article already explains alternate超える; do not create a duplicate primary identity.

Actualオーバー and超過 mainly express going beyond a limit rather than outperforming a rival. They are not unrestricted synonyms of凌駕, but broad exceeding/surpassing English labels and quantities can overlap. Propose conservative direct quiz exclusions from each new support word, without claiming their Japanese constructions are interchangeable.

耐える,上回る,乗り切る,忍ぶ and勝る are dictionary-verified comparison candidates but have no exact current articles. Use selectively with readings and no broken links; do not add them merely for comparison. 忍ぶ hasしのぶ and bu-ending conjugation, not凌ぐ'sしのぐ/gu-ending. No quiz exclusion may reference a missing article.

陵 and菱 are visual comparisons only; current cards are absent. 陵's hill sense is restricted toりょう in its full noun family. Do not turn recognized陵駕 into unrestricted modern interchangeability of these shapes or meanings. 菱 plant/weapon senses do not establish an etymology for凌.

extraDecisions.decision: Actual越す and過ぎる have ordinary exceeding/surpassing branches beyond their article headings. 越す also covers overcoming hardship and passing a winter. Propose direct guards from BOTH new words to each identity. Do not use shared exclusions through越える to claim these pairs are already protected.
Homographic過ぎるよぎる is a separate usually-kana godan family. It must not be assigned to the actual過ぎるすぎる article or used to change that existing primary reading.
